    rw [not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton] at hzero

findings.problem: The proof that a subsingleton graded module is a zero object (`IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero`, then `hom_ext`, then `LinearMap.ext`, then `Subsingleton.elim`) is repeated inline. The `Nontrivial Y` block just above it (lines 59–63) has the same shape. The same `IsZero`/`Subsingleton` conversion is also rebuilt by hand in at least four other places: `finrank_pos_of_not_isZero` and `isEmpty_iso_shiftObj` in CartanMap/ProjectiveBasis.lean, and `hM` and `hM : IsZero M` in `laurentK0_of_mem_span` in CartanMap/SimpleBasis.lean. The SimpleBasis `hM` proves the converse direction, from a nonzero element to `¬IsZero`, by using `hM.eq_of_src` and `LinearMap.congr_fun`. Each copy re-derives the link between the categorical zero object and the underlying module being trivial, and no lemma names this link.
findings.proposed_change: Add one lemma next to the abelian-structure API, for example `theorem GradedModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton (M : GradedModuleCat.{v} 𝒜) : IsZero M ↔ Subsingleton M`. For `→`, use `hM.eq_of_src (𝟙 M) 0` and apply `LinearMap.congr_fun` to `Hom.hom` at each `x`, which gives `x = 0`. For `←`, use `(IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero M).2 (hom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun _ ↦ Subsingleton.elim _ _))`. Then rewrite the `Q` block as `have : Nontrivial Q := not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial.1 fun h ↦ hQ ((isZero_iff_subsingleton Q).2 h)`. Rewrite the `Y` block as `not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial.1 fun h ↦ hi₀ (((isZero_iff_subsingleton Y).2 h).eq_of_src i 0)`; this relies on `hi₀ : i ≠ 0`, which I did not confirm because the signature of `exists_mono_ne_zero_not_isIso_of_not_simple` was not read. Reuse the lemma in `finrank_pos_of_not_isZero`, `isEmpty_iso_shiftObj`, the two SimpleBasis blocks, and `hM` at SimpleBasis.lean line 84, though that one needs the `←`/`→` direction adapted. No extra imports are needed: the lemma uses only `hom_ext`, `IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero` and `LinearMap` API that this file already uses.
findings.benefit: One named, documented lemma replaces five or more ad hoc reconstructions of the same fact. Each use becomes a one-line step. The main proof here then reads as dimension bookkeeping instead of categorical unfolding. A future change to the `GradedModuleCat` hom or ext API is then made in one place.
